h1: Go-live support for your store launch day
overview: The day you switch the domain is the day people notice mistakes. We agree a launch plan with you, lower the domain's cache time ahead of the switch, point it to the new store and watch the first hours. We check that the new store loads, takes orders and sends emails, that redirects work and that the old site is switched off cleanly. You get a launch log and a short list for the first week.

faq: Will my store be offline during the switch?

Not in most cases. We prepare everything on the new store first and change the domain records at a quiet time. Some visitors may see the old site for a few hours while the change spreads across the internet.
Do I need to own the domain?

Yes, and we need access to the domain settings at your registrar, such as GoDaddy or Namecheap. We guide you through adding the right records yourself, or you can add us as a delegate if the registrar allows it.
What if something goes wrong at launch?
Premium includes a rollback plan that points the domain back to the old store within minutes. For other packages we pause and fix, or reverse the change together, and then agree a new time.
Can you handle a launch on a weekend?
We plan the launch time with you, including evenings and weekends, and confirm it before you order. Launch support for a specific day is booked when the order is placed.
